(payghumbar ne) moonh banaya, aur rukh phirlia.
Us liye ke un ke paas woh nabina aagaya tha.
Aur (ae payghumbar) tumhein kya khabar ? Shayad woh sudhar jata.
Ya woh naseehat qabool karta, aur naseehat karna use faida pahunchata.
Woh shaks jo beproaii dkha raha tha.
Us ke to tum peechhe parte ho.
Halaanke agar woh na sudhre to tum par koi zma daari nahin aati.
Aur woh jo mehnat kar ke tumhare paas aaya hai.
Aur woh dil mein Allah ka khof rakhta hai.
Us ki taraf se tum beproaii baratte ho.
Hrgza aisa nahin chahiye. Yeh quran to ek naseehat hai.
Ab jo chahaye, use yaad karle.
Woh aise saheefon mein darj hai jo bare muqaddas hain.
Unche rtbe wale hain, pakeeza hain.
Un likhne walon ke haath mein rehte hain.
Jo khud bari izzat wale, bohat nek hain.
Khuda ki maar ho aise insan par, woh kitna shukra hai.
(woh zara soche ke) Allah ne use kis cheez se paida kya ?
Nutfe ki ek boondh se, use paida bhi kiya, phir us ko ek khaas andaz bhi diya.
Phir us ke liye raasta bhi aasan banadiya.
Phir use maut di, aur qabar mein pahuncha diya.
Phir jab chahaye ga use dorbara atha kar khra karde ga.
Hargiz nahin ! Jis baat ka Allah ne use hukum diya tha, abhi tak us ne woh poori nahin ki.
Phir zara insan apne khane hi ko dekh le.
Ke hum ne upar se khoob pani barsaya.
Phir hum ne zameen ko ajeeb tarah phara.
Phir hum ne us mein galle ugaye.
Aur angoor aur tarkariyan.
Aur zaitoon aur khajoor.
Aur ghne ghne baghaat.
Aur mewe aur chara.
Sab kuchh tumhare aur tumhare maweshiyon ke faiyde ki khatir.
Aakhir jab woh kaan pharne wali aawaz aa hi jaye gi. (us waqt us shukri ki haqeeqat pata chal jaye gi)
Yeh us din hoga jab insan apne bhai se bhi bhaage ga.
Aur apne man baap se bhi.
Aur apne biwi bacchon se bhi.
(kyunke) un mein se har ek ko us din apni aisi fikr pari hogi ke use dusron ka hosh nahin hoga.
Us roz kitne chehre to chamakte dmkte hon ge.
Haste, khushi manate hue.
Aur kitne chehre us din aise hon ge ke un par khaak pari hogi.
Siyahi ne unhein dhanp rakhha hoga.
Yeh wahi log hon ge jo kafir the, badhkaar the.
